gone: In the AI model picker: the chosen model isn't offered any more.
not-connected: A model option the person can't use until they connect its account. {{model}} is the model's name.
inherit.none: Fills {{automatic}} when no AI model is available.
inherit.automatic: Picker option: the workspace chooses the AI model. {{automatic}} is that model's name.
inherit.default: Picker option: the socio's (AI agent's) default model. {{model}} is its provider and name.
inherit.default-gone: Picker option: the socio's default model is gone. {{automatic}} is the model used instead.
inherit.default-needs-connection: Picker option: the socio's default model needs an account connection. {{model}} is its provider and name, {{automatic}} the model used meanwhile.
inherit.model: A model's provider ({{group}}, such as ChatGPT) and its name ({{model}}).
